audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields say Miasma 'cancels' Twisted Advance mid-dash. Riot's text says grounded enemies cannot USE movement abilities — it prevents the cast, it does not interrupt a dash already in flight, and Twisted Advance is untargetable for that flight.
audit.why: The difference is the whole engage: a player who believes his dash gets cancelled never commits, when the real rule is simply 'start the dash from outside the cloud'.
audit.corrected: whys[1], early, mid, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1] now say the grounding blocks the cast while you stand in it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Petrifying Gaze is described only as a 'face-stun' with no explanation of the rule.
audit.why: Riot's text: it stuns enemies in front of her that are FACING her, and only slows any with their back turned. Turning away converts a 120s ultimate into a slow — the single most actionable fact in this matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and breakdown.cooldowns now state it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and Miasma — the page's focus ability — was never given one.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and only 16s at rank 5; Petrifying Gaze is 120s. Those are the two windows a Maokai actually plays around.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Cassiopeia in both layers while whys[0] describes it as an even, no-combo stage and the packet chart says Skill.
audit.why: One row disagreeing with its own why text.
audit.corrected: Row 0 flipped to Skill in both layers, rating 3/10 to 5/10. Rows 1-6 left as Cassiopeia — layers, prose and packet all agree.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Miasma: 24s at rank 1 — grounded means you cannot cast Twisted Advance while you stand in it, so start the dash from outside the cloud. - Petrifying Gaze: 120s, and it only stuns enemies facing her. - Nature's Grasp: 130s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Grounding stops you casting W while you stand inside it — 24s at rank 1, so dash in from outside the cloud.

edits.before: Track Cassiopeia's Miasma: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. When it is down — W-root + sapling chain.
edits.after: Miasma blocks the cast, not the flight — Twisted Advance is untargetable once launched, so start it outside her cloud.

edits.before: She gets her W (Miasma) grounding online and can drop it on your W (Twisted Advance) dash to cancel your only engage and start stacking poison.
edits.after: Miasma grounds the ground you stand on — inside that cloud you cannot cast Twisted Advance at all, so she fences off your only engage.

edits.before: Her R (Petrifying Gaze) face-stun stops your W-in cold, stunning you mid-engage and letting her kite the reset — your 6 doesn't answer hers.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her and she casts it as you close, so your engage eats the stun unless you turn away first.

edits.before: Her R (Petrifying Gaze) face-stun means your W root no longer guarantees a clean kill — she stuns you on the way in and kites the reset.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her — turn your back as she casts and you eat a slow instead of losing the whole engage.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your only real window, and even that is thin against her. At 2 your W (Twisted Advance) root into Q (Bramble Smash) is a hard trade she cannot match in melee, so step up the instant she walks forward to last-hit and proc Sap Magic off the all-in to heal the chip back. Do not face-tank her Q (Noxious Blast) poke for free — and watch her W (Miasma): if she drops that ground on you mid-dash it grounds you and cancels your W, so bait it or E (Sapling Toss) the spot first.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your only real window, and even that is thin against her. At 2 your W (Twisted Advance) root into Q (Bramble Smash) is a hard trade she cannot match in melee, so step up the instant she walks forward to last-hit and proc Sap Magic off the all-in to heal the chip back. Do not face-tank her Q (Noxious Blast) poke for free — and respect her W (Miasma): standing in that cloud grounds you and you cannot cast W at all, so launch the dash from outside it.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 she starts pulling ahead. Her poison stacks now out-tick your Sap Magic healing, and once she hits 6 her R (Petrifying Gaze) face-stun answers your engage — she stuns you the second you W in and kites the cooldown out. Keep using E (Sapling Toss) for waveclear and to zone her off the brambles she'd otherwise ground you with, and only all-in when her R is down and you've got a gank or her flash is gone.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 she starts pulling ahead. Her poison stacks now out-tick your Sap Magic healing, and once she hits 6 Petrifying Gaze answers your engage — but it stuns only enemies facing her, so turn your back as she casts and take the slow instead. Keep using E (Sapling Toss) for waveclear and to deny the ground she fences you with, and all-in only when that 120s ult is down.

edits.before: Use E (Sapling Toss) to deny her the W (Miasma) ground zone she uses to cancel your dash
edits.after: Use E (Sapling Toss) to deny the W (Miasma) ground she uses to fence off your dash

edits.before: Drop W (Miasma) ground on top of you to cancel your W dash and slow your step-up
edits.after: Drop W (Miasma) under your feet so you cannot cast the dash out, and slow the walk-up

notes: Only 43-48 games in the sample, so the 48.84% figure is soft — the page's 8.5/10 difficulty is not contradicted by it either way. Miasma's grounding is explicit in Riot's own description here (unlike the derived flags on other champions), so it is safe to state; what was not safe was the cancel-mid-dash claim, which the description does not support.
